name: first_duel_play
description: first_duel, then the tutorial duel against Betamon played to its end: every press waits for the duel's state that takes it (the tutorial's message window, the duel's step and awaitingInput, the duel dialog, the cursor), so the presses land in the same game state on the emulator and the port whatever their frame counts. Checkpoints at the duel's phases, the three polygon battles (SUGSEG), the digivolutions, the result screen and back in SAISEG. The duel state is the heap block at 0x800D97B0 (Duel: step +0x818, awaitingInput +0x822, cursorSlot +0x81C, state +0x810); the tutorial window KAW_TUTORIAL_WINDOW (UiWindow.animDone +0x41), the dialog DUEL_DIALOG (closed +0xB4, win.animDone +0x41).
